name: NVIDIA DLSS
description: Experimental DLSS Super Resolution and neural rendering bridge for NVIDIA RTX GPUs. Native uses DLAA at 2560x1440; Quality and lower modes render the 3D scene below native resolution. ReImagined does not yet expose game motion vectors, depth, or a HUD mask, so fast cars and floating labels may ghost.

options.label: Super Resolution
options.help: Native keeps the game at 2560x1440 and uses DLAA. Quality can improve frame rate but may soften moving cars until ReImagined exports motion vectors.

options.label: DLSS neural rendering
options.help: Experimental neural lighting/material reconstruction. It costs performance and currently uses optical-flow fallback data.

options.label: DLSS performance overlay
options.help: Shows the bridge's frame-rate and diagnostic overlay in game.
